خدمات فرعية مصممة لمرحلتك

iOS Apps
 
Native Swift applications for iPhone and iPad
 
 
Pure SwiftUI and UIKit, written in Swift 5.10+ with async/await throughout. We handle App Store submission, TestFlight betas, privacy manifests, and the small things that turn an app from good to great on Apple silicon.
 
     
  • Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine
  • iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV
  • StoreKit, Sign in with Apple, Wallet
  • TestFlight, App Store Connect, and privacy manifests
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
Android Apps
 
Native Kotlin apps for all Android devices
 
 
Kotlin-first Android with Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and the modern AndroidX stack. We build for the long tail of devices your users actually have, with adaptive layouts, predictive back, and a smooth first-run experience.
 
     
  • Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3
  • Adaptive layouts for phones, foldables, and tablets
  • Play Billing, Play Integrity, and Data Safety
  • Internal tracks, staged rollouts, and pre-launch reports
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
Cross-Platform
 
Flutter & React Native for multi-platform reach
 
 
One codebase, two stores, and as much native feel as the platform allows. We pick Flutter for high-fidelity UI and animations, and React Native when the team is already deep in JavaScript and the ecosystem matters.
 
     
  • Flutter 3 with Dart 3, Material You, and Cupertino
  • React Native with Expo, EAS, and Hermes
  • Native modules for Bluetooth, NFC, and camera
  • Shared design system across iOS and Android
    •  
  
 
  
 
 
App Store Optimization
 
Get discovered with proper ASO strategies
 
 
Most apps are never found. We treat the store listing like a product surface — keyword research, screenshot testing, localization, and a steady cadence of experiments so your install graph keeps climbing.
 
     
  • Keyword research and metadata refresh
  • Screenshot and video A/B testing
  • Localization for priority markets
  • Reviews, ratings, and reply workflows

 الأسئلة 
الأسئلة التي نسمعها كثيرًا
 
 
     
  •  
      Should I pick Flutter, React Native, or fully native?     
    It depends on your team, timeline, and platform ambition. We recommend fully native for apps that lean on platform features (Apple Watch, Material You, NFC). Flutter and React Native are great for cross-platform MVPs and most consumer apps. We will recommend the right choice after a short architecture workshop.
     
     
  •  
      Do you handle App Store and Play Store submission?     
    Yes. We manage the whole submission process, including review notes, privacy nutrition labels, Data Safety, signing certificates, and store listing copy. We also set up staged rollouts so you can watch crash-free sessions and roll back if needed.
     
     
  •  
      Can you take over an existing app?     
    Frequently. We do a paid audit first — architecture review, dependency analysis, crash reports, and a one-page plan — then propose a phased engagement. Most rescue projects start with a 2-week stabilization sprint before we touch features.
     
     
  •  
      How do you handle ongoing maintenance?     
    We offer monthly retainer plans that include store updates, dependency upgrades, crash triage, and a small number of feature hours. Most clients keep us on for 6–12 months after launch to keep the app fresh.
